verdict.rationale: A long-time customer reports using purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules (mercury-comm-1), a product-native rule that moves money automatically. First-party docs also mention organization approval policies that gate payments (mercury-docs-55, mercury-docs-47) and automatic recurring invoices (mercury-docs-4). Webhooks and events (mercury-docs-42, mercury-docs-43) are only developer building blocks for building your own rules, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: first-party docs describing a general user-defined rules engine (event triggers, conditions, actions), official documentation of auto-funding rules, AI-native or agent-driven rule configuration, and independent corroboration beyond a single community comment.
